>Or is it an editorial requirement that in RISC-V specifications, a base specification can not refer to optional extensions?

It's an editorial requirement - we must define the base without _any_ optional extensions.
This makes writing the spec very difficult.

Can you change this to adding text into the hybrid chapter instead?

  until a fixed point is reached, arriving at a set of permissions not further reduced by any rule.
  Any permission-dependent capability metadata is to be updated to reflect any permissions removed by this procedure.
  Note that encodings may specify procedures for computing the new permission set; while these must be idempotent and respect the rules of <<sec_permission_transitions>>, they need not be of the form "iterate to fixed point".
